# rail_topology (Data Source)

The configured tier and its direct upstreams, for audit and capacity-planning purposes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rail_topology" "edge" {}

output "edge_upstreams" {
  value = data.rail_topology.edge.upstreams
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The tier's per-process identity.
- `instance` (String) The tier's name.
- `public_url` (String) Base URL links are issued under.
- `upstreams` (List of String) Vendor identifiers, including nested tiers as `rail+<url>`.
